title: Bar Drop Watermelon Ice 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Bar Drop Salts Watermelon Ice by Drop is a refreshing classic that balances sweetness with cool refreshment. It delivers the lush, aqueous taste of red watermelon on the inhale, light and sugary. A blast of ice on the exhale transforms the profile into a chilled experience, perfect for all-day vaping. Mixed with a 40% VG / 60% PG ratio, this e-liquid provides exceptional flavour definition, ensuring the delicate watermelon notes are crisp and distinct. Perfect for MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) devices, the nicotine salt formula ensures a smooth draw in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths. Bar Drop Salts is a range of nic salt e-liquids from UK manufacturer, Drop, that specialises in creating fruity flavours of astonishing authenticity and clarity.
